notes: SEQN is the NHANES participant identifier, mapped to person_source_value to retain the original identifier.
Dietary day one sample weight is a survey design weight, stored as a numeric observation with a custom concept for survey weights.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey design weight, stored as a numeric observation.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating the status of the recall; mapped to value_as_concept_id with a custom concept.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer, stored as a string observation.
Breast-fed infant indicator is a binary variable; mapped to value_as_concept_id with a custom concept for Yes/No.
Number of days of intake is a categorical variable; mapped to value_as_concept_id with a custom concept.
Number of days between intake and household interview is a continuous numeric variable.
Intake day of the week is a categorical variable; mapped to value_as_concept_id with a custom concept for days of week.
Language used mostly is a categorical variable; mapped to value_as_concept_id with a custom concept for languages.
Main respondent indicator is categorical; mapped to value_as_concept_id with a custom concept.
Helped in responding indicator is categorical; mapped to value_as_concept_id with a custom concept.
Number of foods reported is a continuous numeric variable.
Energy (kcal) is a measurement of total caloric intake. Standard concept_id 4328813 represents 'Energy' in OMOP.
Protein (gm) is a measurement of total protein intake. Standard concept_id 4075927 represents 'Protein' in OMOP.

Maps to OMOP Measurement of Cholesterol intake. Concept 4065413 represents Cholesterol measured in milligrams.
